narr: Scattered afternoon thunderstorms developed in a summertime airmass with a couple of severe storms occurring in Lowndes county with impacts to trees and power lines. In addition, a very moist airmass and weak steering flow led to flash flooding across portions of southwest Georgia.
ev: Flash flooding was reported on Palmyra Road.
Several inches of water was reported in some homes along Red Tip Lane, Wax Myrtle Dr, Ivy Lane, and Loblolly Lane.
Several roads south of Blakely were flooded with water covering them.
Several secondary roads were flooded in Early county.
Flash flooding was reported on State Highway 32 in both directions near Mossy Dell Road with all lanes closed.
lsr: Water was reported over Highway 76 but has since receded.
Several roads south of Blakely have water over them or are beginning to flood.
Continued flooding of secondary roads in Early County.
Flooding was reported on Palmyra Road.
Several inches of water in some homes along Red Tip Lane, Wax Myrtle Dr, Ivy Lane, and Loblolly Lane.
Flooding on SR 32 both directions at MOSSY DELL RD. All lanes closed.
